answer_1.quote: We investigate the LLM‑guided conversation ... GUIDELLM is tasked with conducting interviews over 23 different topics, ultimately producing an autobiography ...
datasets: An Autobiography by Catherine Helen Spence

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the Interviewing Quality (coverage, correctness, recall, F1), Conversation Quality (fluency, identification, comforting) and Autobiography Generation (insightfulness, narrativity, emotional impact).

answer_3.quote: We utilize the popular LLM‑as‑a‑judge evaluation to make GPT‑4 decide which conversation is better and which autobiography is higher quality.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a within‑subject study with 45 participants ... participants indicated which model performed better, provided reasonings, and rated conversation quality.
answer_4.guideline: Participants interact with each chatbot, then provide feedback, preferences, and ratings on conversation and autobiography quality.
